Delhi protests: Home Secretary apologizes to Supreme Court in contempt case

The Union Home Secretary has tendered an unconditional apology to the Supreme Court in a contempt case related to Delhi protests. The Supreme Court's docket also includes a police crackdown and the detention of journalists. Protests in Delhi have led to these legal proceedings.
